discovery.hypothesis: Covers published a Bruins moneyline pick for the game starting at 1:10 PM EST on Sunday, Nov. 8. Florida is listed without Barkov, Marchand, Lundell and Vilmanis. A second Covers pick on Boston makes the same argument, so treat both as one lead.
